title: Iron pickaxe

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Iron pickaxe is the third Pickaxe. It can be used to mine Obsidian and Silver, in addition to what previous pickaxes can mine.
Its primary attack is a melee attack that destroys ground. It does not have a secondary attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The attack hitbox reaches below the player's feet, allowing them to dig down. This easily causes a 33% damage penalty for hitting the ground when not above or very close to the target.

Iron pickaxe

Internal ID: PickaxeIron | Type: Pickaxe | Source: Forge | Usage: Mining | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Corewood x3, Iron x30 | Attack speed: 1.4 s | Hitbox: 1.8 range, 120 angle, 1.0 height, 0.2 ray, vertical | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Iron pickaxe is the third Pickaxe. It can be used to mine Obsidian and Silver, in addition to what previous pickaxes can mine.
Its primary attack is a melee attack that destroys ground. It does not have a secondary attack.

Notes. • The attack hitbox reaches below the player's feet, allowing them to dig down. This easily causes a 33% damage penalty for hitting the ground when not above or very close to the target.
